text: ok now i can at least see the world. camera is broken / doesnt move. it zooms. and the startup time just went from 30s to 3s so yes the whole time i was right
resolution: The loader iso pane's camera was non-functional (only zoom worked) because the embedded world_loader ran its full game: it captured the mouse for in-world look and read SDL WASD to walk the player, shadowing the editor's JS camera controls — only the scroll wheel fell through (hence zoom-only). Fixed by making the loader a PASSIVE viewport in external-camera (editor) mode: world_loader.zig freezes player locomotion + exposes isExternalCamera(node_id); engine.zig skips pointer capture for an editor-driven loader so drag reaches the pane's JS overlay (rotates the iso camera); LoaderIsoView drives drag-rotate (e.x-relative, like IsoAuthor), wheel-zoom, and WASD/arrow pan + Q/E orbit + F recenter via a direct key-bus subscription (the editor control contract was swallowing WASD for this pane). User confirmed drag-rotate works and the player is frozen. WASD pan (req_1777) is the same commit, pending the user's confirmation.
